title: crataegus monogyna f. azarella
intro: Crataegus monogyna f. azarella, commonly known as hawthorn, is a flowering plant species within the Rosaceae family, known for its distinctive thorny branches and small white flowers. The plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of hawthorn are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit vasodilatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. Regular consumption of hawthorn has been associated with reduced oxidative stress, improved lipid profiles, and overall cardiovascular well-being.
